diagnoses.name: atrial fibrillation
diagnoses.explanation_patient_lang: This is an irregular heartbeat that can increase your risk of having a stroke.

diagnoses.name: high blood pressure
diagnoses.explanation_patient_lang: Your blood pressure was measured at 152/94 today, which is higher than it should be.

medications.name: apixaban
medications.frequency: twice a day, morning and evening
medications.explanation_patient_lang: This is a new blood thinner to help prevent strokes. Take it twice every day.

medications.name: lisinopril
medications.explanation_patient_lang: We are increasing your dose from 10 mg to 20 mg to better control your blood pressure.

medications.name: ibuprofen
medications.explanation_patient_lang: Stop taking this or Advil because it increases your risk of bleeding while on a blood thinner.

medications.name: Advil
medications.explanation_patient_lang: Stop taking this medication to avoid bleeding risks with your new blood thinner.

medications.name: Tylenol
medications.explanation_patient_lang: Use this instead of ibuprofen for pain relief.

exercises.name: walking
form_cues: at a pace where you can still talk
exercises.explanation_patient_lang: Try to walk for 30 minutes most days of the week at a comfortable pace.

care_items.text: check your blood pressure at home every morning and write it down
care_items.text_patient_lang: Please measure your blood pressure every morning and keep a log of the results.

care_items.text: blood test to check your kidneys
care_items.text_patient_lang: You need a blood test to make sure your kidneys are handling the new medication dose well.

care_items.text: see you back here in three months
care_items.text_patient_lang: We will meet again in three months to check on your progress.

care_items.text: black stools, blood in your urine, or bruising that won't stop
care_items.text_patient_lang: Call the office immediately if you see signs of internal bleeding like dark stools or unusual bruising.

care_items.text: face drooping, arm weakness, or trouble speaking
care_items.text_patient_lang: Call 911 immediately if you have signs of a stroke like weakness or difficulty talking.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.original: Good morning, Mr. Johnson. I'm Dr. Patel. How have you been feeling since your last visit?
utterances.translated: Good morning, Mr. Johnson. I'm Dr. Patel. How have you been feeling since your last visit?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.original: Mostly okay. But my heart sometimes flutters, and I get tired walking up the stairs.
utterances.translated: Mostly okay. But my heart sometimes flutters, and I get tired walking up the stairs.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.original: Your monitor results came back. The fluttering is atrial fibrillation. It's an irregular heartbeat, and it raises the risk of stroke.
utterances.translated: Your monitor results came back. The fluttering is atrial fibrillation. It's an irregular heartbeat, and it raises the risk of stroke.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.original: It's very manageable. I'm starting you on apixaban, a blood thinner. Five milligrams, twice a day, morning and evening. Don't skip doses.
utterances.translated: It's very manageable. I'm starting you on apixaban, a blood thinner. Five milligrams, twice a day, morning and evening. Don't skip doses.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.original: Your blood pressure is also high today, 152 over 94. I'm increasing your lisinopril from 10 milligrams to 20 milligrams, once a day.
utterances.translated: Your blood pressure is also high today, 152 over 94. I'm increasing your lisinopril from 10 milligrams to 20 milligrams, once a day.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.original: Please stop taking ibuprofen or Advil. With the blood thinner, it raises your bleeding risk. Use Tylenol for pain instead.
utterances.translated: Please stop taking ibuprofen or Advil. With the blood thinner, it raises your bleeding risk. Use Tylenol for pain instead.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.original: I'd like you to walk thirty minutes a day, five days a week, at a pace where you can still talk. And check your blood pressure at home every morning and write it down.
utterances.translated: I'd like you to walk thirty minutes a day, five days a week, at a pace where you can still talk. And check your blood pressure at home every morning and write it down.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.original: We'll do a blood test in one week to check your kidneys after the dose change, and I'll see you back here in three months.
utterances.translated: We'll do a blood test in one week to check your kidneys after the dose change, and I'll see you back here in three months.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.original: Call us right away if you notice black stools, blood in your urine, or bruising that won't stop. And call 911 if you have face drooping, arm weakness, or trouble speaking.
utterances.translated: Call us right away if you notice black stools, blood in your urine, or bruising that won't stop. And call 911 if you have face drooping, arm weakness, or trouble speaking.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.original: Alright, I think that's everything for today. Do you have any other questions before you go?
utterances.translated: Alright, I think that's everything for today. Do you have any other questions before you go?

summary.summary_doctor_lang: The patient is diagnosed with atrial fibrillation and hypertension, with a blood pressure reading of 152/94 today. To mitigate stroke risk, I have initiated apixaban 5 mg twice daily and increased lisinopril to 20 mg daily for better blood pressure control. The patient was instructed to discontinue ibuprofen and Advil to minimize bleeding risks, substituting with Tylenol as needed. A follow-up blood test is scheduled for one week to monitor renal function, and a return visit is planned for three months. I also advised the patient to engage in moderate walking 30 minutes daily and maintain a home blood pressure log.
summary.summary_patient_lang: Today we talked about your heart fluttering, which is called atrial fibrillation. This condition and your high blood pressure of 152/94 mean we need to make some changes to keep you safe from a stroke. You will start a new blood thinner called apixaban and take a higher dose of your blood pressure medicine, lisinopril. It is very important that you stop taking Advil or ibuprofen because they can cause dangerous bleeding when mixed with your new medicine; use Tylenol for pain instead. Please walk for 30 minutes most days and write down your blood pressure every morning. Please confirm anything unclear with the care team.
key_points_patient_lang: You have an irregular heartbeat and high blood pressure.
Take apixaban 5 mg twice a day and lisinopril 20 mg once a day.
Stop taking Advil or ibuprofen; use Tylenol for pain instead.
Get a blood test in one week and return for a visit in three months.
Call 911 if you have face drooping, arm weakness, or trouble speaking.
Call the doctor if you see black stools, blood in your urine, or bruising that won't stop.
